messages:
maria_g: FYI we saw a spike of mTLS handshake failures from eu-proxy-12x at 09:12 UTC. KMS unwraps succeeded but the proxy logged certificates missing from keystore cache. Looks like TTL mismatch between rotator metadata and keystore expires. cc @aj @sam_k
aj: can you paste a couple of logs and the keystore audit id? are these all the same pool?
sam_k: yes same pool. quick sample: 2026-03-21T09:12:03Z eu-proxy-12x ERROR tls: certificate not found in keystore (alias=svc-prod-eu, event=EVICT_2026-03-21T09:11:58Z) and keystore audit evt id audit://keystore/evt-84999 shows unwrap at 09:11:59 then TTL_SET=3600 while rotator meta had ttl=7200.
maria_g: so rotator updated s3 meta but the keystore write was partially blocked by an IAM deny due to yesterday's role prune. audit sampling at 10% missed that deny chain.
aj: immediate actions: increase keystore write audit sampling to 100% for 12h and create an alert for ttl delta >30% or >300s between rotator and keystore. also pause TTL normalization job until RBAC is validated.
sam_k: opening INFRA-2150 to track RBAC repro in staging and attach KMS unwrap logs + diff of meta/aliases.json vs keystore metadata. will also push keystore schema change to include source_actor_context (deploy-tag, role, request-id) on TTL set ops.
infra-bot: alertbot: 09:15 UTC 1 handshake failures aggregated, ticket INFRA-2150 created.
maria_g: aj approved temporary pause at 09:40 UTC: https://internal.ops/rotator/jobs/ttl-normalize (paused by aj).
aj: follow-ups assigned: sam_k -> keystore audit schema change and rollout, infra -> audit sampling bump, sec -> add SLO alert and forensic export of last 48h keystore writes. update ticket.
maria_g: we'll run a short postmortem tomorrow to capture detection gaps and update the runbook. closing loop for now. :thumbsup:
